يطمأنن (form IVq)

# يَطْمَأْنِنْ (yaṭmaʔnin) /jatˤ.maʔ.nin/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# يُطْمَأْنَنْ (yuṭmaʔnan) /jutˤ.maʔ.nan/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of ا
